3,041 likes, 4 comments - komalgudan on October 3, 2026: "Sunday Wellness with Komal 🌿

Today’s wellness star: Ragi! One ingredient I genuinely love for its nutrition, versatility and how easy it is to include in everyday meals.

My little one has been eating ragi since he was six months old, and now at 2.5 years, it’s still something we enjoy in different forms. 🤍

One of my favourites is Ragi Ambli — cook the ragi, let it ferment, then add water, curd, your favourite veggies and a few spices. Simple!

It’s refreshing, naturally cooling and a lovely way to add wholesome nutrition to your day.

Ragi is an ancient Asian grain that’s making its way back into our kitchens — and honestly, I’m so glad it is! ✨
